summary: Will Toor (60) and Mariella Colvin (59) tumbled 900 feet down the East Couloir of Flattop Mountain when a cornice collapsed; both unroped; Toor was helicoptered out with a broken femur and Colvin evacuated the next day with broken ribs, sternum, wrist and vertebrae; NPS rescue.
location: East Couloir, Flattop Mountain, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: ANAC 2023 edition (Pub 2023); incident date Jul 10 per article. NPS ROMO morning-report compendium entry; describes the easternmost chute of the Ptarmigan Fingers above Odessa Lake (same feature as the row's "East Couloir, Flattop Mountain"). Run 602: NPS incident release URL merged (Ptarmigan Fingers = East Couloir Flattop, per run-529 compendium note; release parent-verified this run).
